versions.content: On reception of a request for UDS Service InputOutput- ControlByIdentifier (0x2F) , if all verifications have been successfully done (see [SWS_Dcm_00563], [SWS_Dcm_00565], [SWS_Dcm_00566], [SWS_Dcm_00567] ) and if the data is configured as a "ECU signal" of the IoHwAb (parameter DcmD- spDataUsePort ), the Dcm shall call the Api IoHwAb_Dcm_<symbolic name of ECU signal (parameter DcmDspDataEcuSignal )>() with InputOutputControlParam- eter for the 'action' parameter and in case of InputOutputControlParameter is set to 'shortTermAdjustment' the signal value for the "signal" parameter. In this case the requirements [SWS_Dcm_00396], [SWS_Dcm_00397], [SWS_Dcm_00398] and [SWS_Dcm_00399] doesn't apply.
